name: Shimmering Cave
description: A damp cavern rich in iron ore and glowing fungi. Cave bats flutter in the darkness.
visualTheme: A cool, dark cave lit by patches of phosphorescent blue moss, with dripping water and mineral veins glittering on the walls.

history.createdWhy: Formed by sub-surface water channels eroding the limestone deposits.
history.majorEvents: Discovered by Ralph Senior during an early mineral expedition.
history.whyExists: Acts as the primary iron and coal mining shaft for the settlement.
history.currentConflicts: Infested with aggressive stone golems blocking the lower tunnels.
